class _StatusHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    """Serve the HTML page and the JSON status endpoint."""

    # Silence the default access log lines.
    def log_message(self, format: str, *args: Any) -> None:
        pass

    def _send(self, status: int, body: str, content_type: str) -> None:
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type)
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body.encode("utf-8"))

    def do_GET(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802
        if self.path == "/status.json":
            self._serve_json()
        elif self.path == "/":
            self._serve_html()
        else:
            self._send(404, "Not Found", "text/plain")

    def _serve_json(self) -> None:
        result = collect_status(self._runs_dir, datetime.now(timezone.utc))
        self._send(200, json.dumps(result, indent=2), "application/json; charset=utf-8")

    def _serve_html(self) -> None:
        import html as _html

        result = collect_status(self._runs_dir, datetime.now(timezone.utc))
        current = result["current"]

        # Status line & title.
        if current:
            status_text = f"RUNNING: {_html.escape(str(current.get('title', '')))}"
        elif result["recent"]:
            # Find the newest finished run's finished_at.
            newest_finished = result["recent"][0]  # already sorted newest first
            finished_at = _html.escape(str(newest_finished.get("finished_at", "")))
            status_text = f"IDLE — last run finished {finished_at}"
        else:
            status_text = "IDLE"

        # Current run panel.
        if current:
            c_title = _html.escape(str(current.get("title", "")))
            c_kind = _html.escape(str(current.get("kind", "")))
            c_id = _html.escape(str(current.get("task_id", "")))
            c_pipeline = _html.escape(str(current.get("pipeline", "") or "—"))
            c_duration = _format_duration(current["duration_seconds"])
            c_turns = current.get("turns", 0)
            c_tool_calls = current.get("tool_calls", 0)
            c_last_activity = current.get("last_activity_seconds_ago")
            if c_last_activity is not None:
                c_activity_str = f"last activity {c_last_activity}s ago"
            else:
                c_activity_str = ""
            current_panel = f"""\
<h2>Current run</h2>
<p>
  <strong>Title:</strong> {c_title}  
  <strong>Kind:</strong> {c_kind}  
  <strong>ID:</strong> {c_id}  
  <strong>Pipeline:</strong> {c_pipeline}  
  <strong>Elapsed:</strong> {c_duration}
</p>
<p>
  <strong>Turns:</strong> {c_turns}  
  <strong>Tool calls:</strong> {c_tool_calls}
  {f'<br><strong>{c_activity_str}</strong>' if c_activity_str else ''}
</p>"""
        else:
            current_panel = "<h2>Current run</h2><p>None</p>"

        # Build groups and tables.
        section_parts: list[str] = []
        for group in result["groups"]:
            g_pipeline = _html.escape(str(group["pipeline"])) if group["pipeline"] is not None else "No pipeline"
            g_running = group["running"]
            g_finished = group["finished"]
            g_runs = group["runs"]  # all runs in this pipeline, newest first

            section_parts.append(f"<h2>Pipeline: {g_pipeline} ({g_running} running, {g_finished} finished)</h2>")

            # Table for this group's runs.
            rows: list[str] = []
            for run in result["recent"]:
                if run.get("pipeline") != group["pipeline"]:
                    continue
                r_title = _html.escape(str(run.get("title", "")))
                r_kind = _html.escape(str(run.get("kind", "")))
                r_id = _html.escape(str(run.get("task_id", "")))
                r_dur = _format_duration(run["duration_seconds"])

                # State column.
                if "finished_at" in run:
                    state = "finished"
                else:
                    state = "running"

                # Detail column.
                detail_str = _format_detail(run.get("kind"), run.get("detail", {}))
                if detail_str:
                    detail_str = _html.escape(detail_str)

                started_at = run.get("started_at", "")
                if started_at:
                    try:
                        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(started_at)
                        if dt.tzinfo:
                            started_local = dt.astimezone().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                        else:
                            started_local = dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                        started_at = _html.escape(started_local)
                    except ValueError:
                        started_at = _html.escape(started_at)
                else:
                    started_at = "—"

                rows.append(
                    f"<tr>"
                    f"<td>{r_id}</td>"
                    f"<td>{r_kind}</td>"
                    f"<td>{r_title}</td>"
                    f"<td>{state}</td>"
                    f"<td title='UTC start: {run.get(\"started_at\", \"\")}'>{started_at}</td>"
                    f"<td>{r_dur}</td>"
                    f"<td>{detail_str}</td>"
                    f"</tr>"
                )

            if not rows:
                rows.append("<tr><td colspan=\"7\">No recent runs in this group</td></tr>")
            rows_html = "\n".join(rows)

            section_parts.append(f"""\
<div style="overflow-x: auto;">
<table>
<thead>
  <tr><th>ID</th><th>Kind</th><th>Title</th><th>State</th><th>Started (local time)</th><th>Duration</th><th>Detail</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
{rows_html}
</tbody>
</table>
</div>""")

        if not section_parts:
            section_parts.append("<h2>Pipelines</h2><p>No runs yet.</p>")

        sections_html = "\n".join(section_parts)

        page = f"""\
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<title>{status_text}</title>
<meta http-equiv="refresh" content="10">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<style>
  body {{ font-family: sans-serif; margin: 2em; }}
  table {{ border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; }}
  th, td {{ border: 1px solid #ccc; padding: 4px 8px; text-align: left; }}
  th {{ background: #f4f4f4; }}
  h1 {{ font-size: 1.4em; }}
  h2 {{ font-size: 1.1em; margin-top: 1.5em; }}
  @media (max-width: 600px) {{
    body {{ margin: 1em; }}
    .scrollable {{ overflow-x: auto; }}
  }}
</style>
</head>
<body>
{status_text}
{current_panel}
<h2>Recent runs</h2>
{sections_html}
</body>
</html>
"""
        self._send(200, page, "text/html; charset=utf-8")


def _cmd_serve(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    runs_dir = args._runs if args._runs else Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "evaluation" / "runs"
    host = args.host or DEFAULT_HOST
    port = args.port or DEFAULT_PORT

    handler: type[_StatusHandler] = type(
        "_StatusHandler",
        (_StatusHandler,),
        {"_runs_dir": runs_dir},
    )

    server = ThreadingHTTPServer((host, port), handler)
    print(f"Serving on http://{host}:{port}/")
    try:
        server.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        server.shutdown()
    return 0


def _build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.strip())
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command")

    st = sub.add_parser("status", help="print the current status as JSON to stdout")
    st.add_argument(
        "--runs",
        type=Path,
        default=None,
        dest="_runs",
        help="path to the evaluation/runs directory (defaults to evaluation/runs next to this script)",
    )
    st.add_argument("--now", type=_parse_now, help="pin the current time as ISO-8601 (for tests)")
    st.set_defaults(func=_cmd_status)

    sv = sub.add_parser("serve", help="run a loopback HTTP server")
    sv.add_argument(
        "--runs",
        type=Path,
        default=None,
        dest="_runs",
        help="path to the evaluation/runs directory (defaults to evaluation/runs next to this script)",
    )
    sv.add_argument("--host", default=DEFAULT_HOST, help="bind address (default: loopback only)")
    sv.add_argument("--port", type=_port_number, default=DEFAULT_PORT, help="port to listen on")
    sv.set_defaults(func=_cmd_serve)

    return parser


def main() -> int:
    parser = _build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not args.command:
        parser.print_help()
        return 1
    return args.func(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except SystemExit:
        raise

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Incremental event-file reader
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class IncrementalReaderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Test the incremental _count_events_incremental over temporary files."""

    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.tmpdir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.events = Path(self.tmpdir.name) / "events.jsonl"
        # Clear the module cache so tests are isolated.
        import status_page
        status_page._events_cache.clear()

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.tmpdir.cleanup()
        import status_page
        status_page._events_cache.clear()

    def test_basic_counts(self) -> None:
        """3 turn_end, 2 tool_execution_end, 1 text, 1 not json → turns==3, tool_calls==2."""
        lines = [
            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
            '{"type":"tool_execution_end"}',
            '{"type":"tool_execution_end"}',
            '{"type":"text"}',
            "not json at all",
        ]
        self.events.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        import status_page
        turns, tool_calls = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 3)
        self.assertEqual(tool_calls, 2)

    def test_incremental_append(self) -> None:
        """Read once (2 turns), append one more turn_end, read again → turns==3."""
        self.events.write_text(
            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"tool_execution_end"}\n',
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        import status_page
        turns, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 1)
        # Append another turn_end line.
        self.events.write_text(
            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"tool_execution_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n',
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        turns, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 2)

    def test_incremental_proven_overwrite_first_line(self) -> None:
        """Read once with 2 turn_end lines; overwrite first line in-place with same byte length; read again → counts unchanged.

        A reader that re-reads from byte 0 would count one extra turn.
        A correct incremental reader that only reads the appended delta
        must return the same counts.
        """
        # Write two turn_end lines, each exactly 23 bytes ("{\"type\":\"turn_end\"}\n" = 23).
        line1 = '{"type":"turn_end"}\n'  # 23 bytes
        line2 = '{"type":"turn_end"}\n'  # 23 bytes
        self.events.write_text(line1 + line2, encoding="utf-8")
        import status_page
        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns1, 2)

        # Overwrite first line in-place with a *different* turn_end line padded
        # to exactly the same byte length.
        new_line1 = '{"type":"turn_end  "}\n'  # 23 bytes (same length)
        with self.events.open("rb") as fh:
            data = fh.read()
        # Replace first 23 bytes
        data = new_line1.encode("utf-8") + data[23:]
        with self.events.open("wb") as fh:
            fh.write(data)

        # Read again — a correct incremental reader should NOT re-count.
        turns2, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns2, 2)  # unchanged

    def test_partial_last_line(self) -> None:
        """File ends with incomplete JSON object (no trailing newline); read; complete; read again."""
        # Write one complete line + a partial line.
        self.events.write_text(
            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_en',
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        import status_page
        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns1, 1)  # only the complete line counted

        )

        self.events.write_text('{"type":"turn_end"}\n', encoding="utf-8")

        self.assertEqual(turns2, 1)  # restarted from zero

    def test_last_activity_seconds_ago(self) -> None:
        """Set file mtime to now−42s → last_activity_seconds_ago ≈ 42.0."""

class PipelineGroupTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Test pipeline grouping in collect_status."""

    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.tmpdir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.runs = Path(self.tmpdir.name) / "runs"
        self.runs.mkdir()
        self.now = datetime(2026, 8, 19, 10, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.tmpdir.cleanup()

    def test_two_pipelines_grouped(self) -> None:
        """Three f03 runs (one running, two finished) + one no-pipeline → two groups."""
        # f03 running
        _write_started(self.runs, "f03-r1", "task", "F03 running",
                       "2026-08-19T10:00:00+00:00", pipeline="f03")
        # f03 finished (newer)
        run_dir_f2 = _write_started(self.runs, "f03-f1", "task", "F03 finished",
                                    "2026-08-19T09:00:00+00:00", pipeline="f03")
        _write_terminal(run_dir_f2, "run.json", "2026-08-19T09:05:00+00:00")
        # f03 finished (older)
        run_dir_f3 = _write_started(self.runs, "f03-f2", "task", "F03 old",
                                    "2026-08-19T08:00:00+00:00", pipeline="f03")
        _write_terminal(run_dir_f3, "run.json", "2026-08-19T08:05:00+00:00")
        # No pipeline
        run_dir_np = _write_started(self.runs, "np-1", "task", "No pipeline",
                                    "2026-08-19T09:30:00+00:00")
        _write_terminal(run_dir_np, "run.json", "2026-08-19T09:35:00+00:00")

        result = collect_status(self.runs, self.now)
        groups = result["groups"]
        self.assertEqual(len(groups), 2)

        # First group: f03
        f03_group = groups[0]
        self.assertEqual(f03_group["pipeline"], "f03")
        self.assertEqual(f03_group["running"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(f03_group["finished"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(f03_group["runs"], ["f03-r1", "f03-f1", "f03-f2"])

        # Second group: no pipeline
        null_group = groups[1]
        self.assertIsNone(null_group["pipeline"])
        self.assertEqual(null_group["running"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(null_group["finished"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(null_group["runs"], ["np-1"])

    def test_pipeline_in_run_records(self) -> None:
        """Every run record (running and finished) gains a pipeline key."""
        run_dir = _write_started(self.runs, "rp1", "task", "R1",
                                 "2026-08-19T10:00:00+00:00", pipeline="f03")
        _write_terminal(run_dir, "run.json", "2026-08-19T10:01:00+00:00")
        _write_started(self.runs, "rp2", "task", "R2",
                       "2026-08-19T10:05:00+00:00", pipeline="f03")
        result = collect_status(self.runs, self.now)
        self.assertEqual(result["recent"][0].get("pipeline"), "f03")
        self.assertEqual(result["current"].get("pipeline"), "f03")

    def test_pipeline_null_when_missing(self) -> None:
        """Run without pipeline key → pipeline is None in record and groups."""
        run_dir = _write_started(self.runs, "pn", "task", "Plain",
                                 "2026-08-19T10:00:00+00:00")
        _write_terminal(run_dir, "run.json", "2026-08-19T10:01:00+00:00")
        result = collect_status(self.runs, self.now)
        self.assertIsNone(result["recent"][0].get("pipeline"))
        null_groups = [g for g in result["groups"] if g["pipeline"] is None]
        self.assertEqual(len(null_groups), 1)

    def test_group_runs_includes_all_not_only_recent(self) -> None:
        """Twelve finished f03 runs → recent has 10, but group runs has 12."""
        for i in range(12):
            run_dir = _write_started(
                self.runs, f"f03-f{i:02d}", "task", f"F03 run {i}",
                f"2026-08-19T{10 + i:02d}:00:00+00:00", pipeline="f03",
            )
            _write_terminal(run_dir, "run.json",
                            f"2026-08-19T{10 + i:02d}:01:00+00:00")
        result = collect_status(self.runs, self.now)
        self.assertEqual(len(result["recent"]), 10)
        f03_groups = [g for g in result["groups"] if g["pipeline"] == "f03"]
        self.assertEqual(len(f03_groups), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(f03_groups[0]["runs"]), 12)

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.server.shutdown()
        self.tmpdir.cleanup()

    def test_status_json_matches_collect_status(self) -> None:
        """GET /status.json body (minus generated_at and *_seconds_ago) equals collect_status."""
        resp = urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}/status.json")
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
        ref_now = datetime.fromisoformat(data.pop("generated_at"))
        expected = collect_status(self.runs, ref_now)
        expected.pop("generated_at")
        # Strip *_seconds_ago for comparison (they depend on request time).
        for run_list in ("running", "recent"):
            for r in data.get(run_list, []):
                r.pop("last_activity_seconds_ago", None)
        for r in expected.get("running", []):
            r.pop("last_activity_seconds_ago", None)
        self.assertEqual(data, expected)

    def test_read_only(self) -> None:
        """collect_status and HTTP requests must not create or modify any file."""
        def _snapshot() -> set[str]:
            paths = set()
            for p in self.runs.rglob("*"):
                if p.is_file():
                    paths.add(str(p))
            return paths

        before = _snapshot()

        # collect_status
        import status_page
        collect_status(self.runs, datetime.now(timezone.utc))

        # HTTP requests
        urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}/status.json")
        urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}/")

        after = _snapshot()
        self.assertEqual(before, after,
                         f"Files changed: +{after - before} -{before - after}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Incremental event-file reader
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class IncrementalReaderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Test the incremental _count_events_incremental over temporary files."""

    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.tmpdir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.events = Path(self.tmpdir.name) / "events.jsonl"
        # Clear the module cache so tests are isolated.
        import status_page
        status_page._events_cache.clear()

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.tmpdir.cleanup()
        import status_page
        status_page._events_cache.clear()

    def test_basic_counts(self) -> None:
        """3 turn_end, 2 tool_execution_end, 1 text, 1 not json → turns==3, tool_calls==2."""
        lines = [
            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
            '{"type":"tool_execution_end"}',
            '{"type":"tool_execution_end"}',
            '{"type":"text"}',
            "not json at all",
        ]
        self.events.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        import status_page
        turns, tool_calls = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 3)
        self.assertEqual(tool_calls, 2)

    def test_incremental_append(self) -> None:
        """Read once (2 turns), append one more turn_end, read again → turns==3."""
        self.events.write_text(
            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"tool_execution_end"}\n',
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        import status_page
        turns, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 1)
        # Append another turn_end line.
        self.events.write_text(
            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"tool_execution_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n',
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        turns, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 2)

    def test_incremental_proven_overwrite_first_line(self) -> None:
        """Read once with 2 turn_end lines; overwrite first line in-place with same byte length; read again → counts unchanged.

        A reader that re-reads from byte 0 would count one extra turn.
        A correct incremental reader that only reads the appended delta
        must return the same counts.
        """
        # Write two turn_end lines, each exactly 23 bytes ("{\"type\":\"turn_end\"}\n" = 23).
        line1 = '{"type":"turn_end"}\n'  # 23 bytes
        line2 = '{"type":"turn_end"}\n'  # 23 bytes
        self.events.write_text(line1 + line2, encoding="utf-8")
        import status_page
        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns1, 2)

        # Overwrite first line in-place with a *different* turn_end line padded
        # to exactly the same byte length.
        new_line1 = '{"type":"turn_end  "}\n'  # 23 bytes (same length)
        with self.events.open("rb") as fh:
            data = fh.read()
        # Replace first 23 bytes
        data = new_line1.encode("utf-8") + data[23:]
        with self.events.open("wb") as fh:
            fh.write(data)

        # Read again — a correct incremental reader should NOT re-count.
        turns2, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)

        self.events.write_text(

class PipelineGroupTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Test pipeline grouping in collect_status."""

    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.tmpdir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.runs = Path(self.tmpdir.name) / "runs"
        self.runs.mkdir()
        self.now = datetime(2026, 8, 19, 10, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.tmpdir.cleanup()

    def test_two_pipelines_grouped(self) -> None:
        """Three f03 runs (one running, two finished) + one no-pipeline → two groups."""
        # f03 running
        _write_started(self.runs, "f03-r1", "task", "F03 running",
                       "2026-08-19T10:00:00+00:00", pipeline="f03")
        # f03 finished (newer)
        run_dir_f2 = _write_started(self.runs, "f03-f1", "task", "F03 finished",
                                    "2026-08-19T09:00:00+00:00", pipeline="f03")
        _write_terminal(run_dir_f2, "run.json", "2026-08-19T09:05:00+00:00")
        # f03 finished (older)
        run_dir_f3 = _write_started(self.runs, "f03-f2", "task", "F03 old",
                                    "2026-08-19T08:00:00+00:00", pipeline="f03")
        _write_terminal(run_dir_f3, "run.json", "2026-08-19T08:05:00+00:00")
        # No pipeline
        run_dir_np = _write_started(self.runs, "np-1", "task", "No pipeline",
                                    "2026-08-19T09:30:00+00:00")
        _write_terminal(run_dir_np, "run.json", "2026-08-19T09:35:00+00:00")

        result = collect_status(self.runs, self.now)
        groups = result["groups"]
        self.assertEqual(len(groups), 2)

        # First group: f03
        f03_group = groups[0]
        self.assertEqual(f03_group["pipeline"], "f03")
        self.assertEqual(f03_group["running"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(f03_group["finished"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(f03_group["runs"], ["f03-r1", "f03-f1", "f03-f2"])

        # Second group: no pipeline
        null_group = groups[1]
        self.assertIsNone(null_group["pipeline"])
        self.assertEqual(null_group["running"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(null_group["finished"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(null_group["runs"], ["np-1"])

    def test_pipeline_in_run_records(self) -> None:
        """Every run record (running and finished) gains a pipeline key."""
        run_dir = _write_started(self.runs, "rp1", "task", "R1",
                                 "2026-08-19T10:00:00+00:00", pipeline="f03")
        _write_terminal(run_dir, "run.json", "2026-08-19T10:01:00+00:00")
        _write_started(self.runs, "rp2", "task", "R2",
                       "2026-08-19T10:05:00+00:00", pipeline="f03")
        result = collect_status(self.runs, self.now)
        self.assertEqual(result["recent"][0].get("pipeline"), "f03")
        self.assertEqual(result["current"].get("pipeline"), "f03")

    def test_pipeline_null_when_missing(self) -> None:
        """Run without pipeline key → pipeline is None in record and groups."""
        run_dir = _write_started(self.runs, "pn", "task", "Plain",
                                 "2026-08-19T10:00:00+00:00")
        _write_terminal(run_dir, "run.json", "2026-08-19T10:01:00+00:00")
        result = collect_status(self.runs, self.now)
        self.assertIsNone(result["recent"][0].get("pipeline"))
        null_groups = [g for g in result["groups"] if g["pipeline"] is None]
        self.assertEqual(len(null_groups), 1)

    def test_group_runs_includes_all_not_only_recent(self) -> None:
        """Twelve finished f03 runs → recent has 10, but group runs has 12."""
        for i in range(12):
            run_dir = _write_started(
                self.runs, f"f03-f{i:02d}", "task", f"F03 run {i}",
                f"2026-08-19T{10 + i:02d}:00:00+00:00", pipeline="f03",
            )
            _write_terminal(run_dir, "run.json",
                            f"2026-08-19T{10 + i:02d}:01:00+00:00")
        result = collect_status(self.runs, self.now)
        self.assertEqual(len(result["recent"]), 10)
        f03_groups = [g for g in result["groups"] if g["pipeline"] == "f03"]
        self.assertEqual(len(f03_groups), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(f03_groups[0]["runs"]), 12)

class JsonConsistencyTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Verify that /status.json matches collect_status and that no files are modified."""

    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.tmpdir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.runs = Path(self.tmpdir.name) / "runs"
        self.runs.mkdir()
        self._populate()
        self._start_server()

    def _populate(self) -> None:
        _write_started(self.runs, "jc1", "task", "Json test",
                       "2026-08-19T10:00:00+00:00", pipeline="f03")
        run_dir = _write_started(self.runs, "jc2", "task", "Done",
                                 "2026-08-19T09:00:00+00:00", pipeline="f03")
        _write_terminal(run_dir, "run.json", "2026-08-19T09:05:00+00:00")

    def _start_server(self) -> None:
        from status_page import DEFAULT_HOST, ThreadingHTTPServer, _StatusHandler
        self._handler_class = type(
            "_JsonStatusHandler",
            (_StatusHandler,),
            {"_runs_dir": self.runs},
        )
        self.server = ThreadingHTTPServer((DEFAULT_HOST, 0), self._handler_class)
        self.port = self.server.server_address[1]
        self.server_thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        self.server_thread.start()

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.server.shutdown()
        self.tmpdir.cleanup()

    def test_status_json_matches_collect_status(self) -> None:
        """GET /status.json body (minus generated_at and *_seconds_ago) equals collect_status."""
        resp = urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}/status.json")
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
        ref_now = datetime.fromisoformat(data.pop("generated_at"))
        expected = collect_status(self.runs, ref_now)
        expected.pop("generated_at")
        # Strip *_seconds_ago for comparison (they depend on request time).
        for run_list in ("running", "recent"):
            for r in data.get(run_list, []):
                r.pop("last_activity_seconds_ago", None)
        for r in expected.get("running", []):
            r.pop("last_activity_seconds_ago", None)
        self.assertEqual(data, expected)

    def test_read_only(self) -> None:
        """collect_status and HTTP requests must not create or modify any file."""
        def _snapshot() -> set[str]:
            paths = set()
            for p in self.runs.rglob("*"):
                if p.is_file():
                    paths.add(str(p))
            return paths

        before = _snapshot()

        # collect_status
        import status_page
        collect_status(self.runs, datetime.now(timezone.utc))

        # HTTP requests
        urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}/status.json")
        urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}/")

        after = _snapshot()
        self.assertEqual(before, after,
                         f"Files changed: +{after - before} -{before - after}")

+class IncrementalReaderTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    """Test the incremental _count_events_incremental over temporary files."""
+
+    def setUp(self) -> None:
+        self.tmpdir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+        self.events = Path(self.tmpdir.name) / "events.jsonl"
+        # Clear the module cache so tests are isolated.
+        import status_page
+        status_page._events_cache.clear()
+
+    def tearDown(self) -> None:
+        self.tmpdir.cleanup()
+        import status_page
+        status_page._events_cache.clear()
+
+    def test_basic_counts(self) -> None:
+        """3 turn_end, 2 tool_execution_end, 1 text, 1 not json → turns==3, tool_calls==2."""
+        lines = [
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
+            '{"type":"tool_execution_end"}',
+            '{"type":"tool_execution_end"}',
+            '{"type":"text"}',
+            "not json at all",
+        ]
+        self.events.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        import status_page
+        turns, tool_calls = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns, 3)
+        self.assertEqual(tool_calls, 2)
+
+    def test_incremental_append(self) -> None:
+        """Read once (2 turns), append one more turn_end, read again → turns==3."""
+        self.events.write_text(
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"tool_execution_end"}\n',
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+        import status_page
+        turns, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns, 1)
+        # Append another turn_end line.
+        self.events.write_text(
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"tool_execution_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n',
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+        turns, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns, 2)
+
+    def test_incremental_proven_overwrite_first_line(self) -> None:
+        """Read once with 2 turn_end lines; overwrite first line in-place with same byte length; read again → counts unchanged.
+
+        A reader that re-reads from byte 0 would count one extra turn.
+        A correct incremental reader that only reads the appended delta
+        must return the same counts.
+        """
+        # Write two turn_end lines, each exactly 23 bytes ("{\"type\":\"turn_end\"}\n" = 23).
+        line1 = '{"type":"turn_end"}\n'  # 23 bytes
+        line2 = '{"type":"turn_end"}\n'  # 23 bytes
+        self.events.write_text(line1 + line2, encoding="utf-8")
+        import status_page
+        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns1, 2)
+
+        # Overwrite first line in-place with a *different* turn_end line padded
+        # to exactly the same byte length.
+        new_line1 = '{"type":"turn_end  "}\n'  # 23 bytes (same length)
+        with self.events.open("rb") as fh:
+            data = fh.read()
+        # Replace first 23 bytes
+        data = new_line1.encode("utf-8") + data[23:]
+        with self.events.open("wb") as fh:
+            fh.write(data)
+
+        # Read again — a correct incremental reader should NOT re-count.
+        turns2, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns2, 2)  # unchanged
+
+    def test_partial_last_line(self) -> None:
+        """File ends with incomplete JSON object (no trailing newline); read; complete; read again."""
+        # Write one complete line + a partial line.
+        self.events.write_text(
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_en',
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+        import status_page
+        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns1, 1)  # only the complete line counted
+
+        # Complete the partial line and add a newline.
+        self.events.write_text(
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n',
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+        turns2, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns2, 2)  # now counts both
+
+    def test_file_shrinks(self) -> None:
+        """File shrinks below stored offset → counts restart from zero."""
+        self.events.write_text(
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n',
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+        import status_page
+        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns1, 3)
+
+        # Shrink file to contain only one line.
+        self.events.write_text('{"type":"turn_end"}\n', encoding="utf-8")
+        turns2, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns2, 1)  # restarted from zero

+class IncrementalReaderTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    """Test the incremental _count_events_incremental over temporary files."""
+
+    def setUp(self) -> None:
+        self.tmpdir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+        self.events = Path(self.tmpdir.name) / "events.jsonl"
+        # Clear the module cache so tests are isolated.
+        import status_page
+        status_page._events_cache.clear()
+
+    def tearDown(self) -> None:
+        self.tmpdir.cleanup()
+        import status_page
+        status_page._events_cache.clear()
+
+    def test_basic_counts(self) -> None:
+        """3 turn_end, 2 tool_execution_end, 1 text, 1 not json → turns==3, tool_calls==2."""
+        lines = [
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
+            '{"type":"tool_execution_end"}',
+            '{"type":"tool_execution_end"}',
+            '{"type":"text"}',
+            "not json at all",
+        ]
+        self.events.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        import status_page
+        turns, tool_calls = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns, 3)
+        self.assertEqual(tool_calls, 2)
+
+    def test_incremental_append(self) -> None:
+        """Read once (2 turns), append one more turn_end, read again → turns==3."""
+        self.events.write_text(
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"tool_execution_end"}\n',
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+        import status_page
+        turns, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns, 1)
+        # Append another turn_end line.
+        self.events.write_text(
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"tool_execution_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n',
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+        turns, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns, 2)
+
+    def test_incremental_proven_overwrite_first_line(self) -> None:
+        """Read once with 2 turn_end lines; overwrite first line in-place with same byte length; read again → counts unchanged.
+
+        A reader that re-reads from byte 0 would count one extra turn.
+        A correct incremental reader that only reads the appended delta
+        must return the same counts.
+        """
+        # Write two turn_end lines, each exactly 23 bytes ("{\"type\":\"turn_end\"}\n" = 23).
+        line1 = '{"type":"turn_end"}\n'  # 23 bytes
+        line2 = '{"type":"turn_end"}\n'  # 23 bytes
+        self.events.write_text(line1 + line2, encoding="utf-8")
+        import status_page
+        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns1, 2)
+
+        # Overwrite first line in-place with a *different* turn_end line padded
+        # to exactly the same byte length.
+        new_line1 = '{"type":"turn_end  "}\n'  # 23 bytes (same length)
+        with self.events.open("rb") as fh:
+            data = fh.read()
+        # Replace first 23 bytes
+        data = new_line1.encode("utf-8") + data[23:]
+        with self.events.open("wb") as fh:
+            fh.write(data)
+
+        # Read again — a correct incremental reader should NOT re-count.
+        turns2, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns2, 2)  # unchanged
+
+    def test_partial_last_line(self) -> None:
+        """File ends with incomplete JSON object (no trailing newline); read; complete; read again."""
+        # Write one complete line + a partial line.
+        self.events.write_text(
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_en',
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+        import status_page
+        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns1, 1)  # only the complete line counted
+
+        # Complete the partial line and add a newline.
+        self.events.write_text(
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n',
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+        turns2, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns2, 2)  # now counts both
+
+    def test_file_shrinks(self) -> None:
+        """File shrinks below stored offset → counts restart from zero."""
+        self.events.write_text(
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n',
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+        import status_page
+        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns1, 3)

+        # Shrink file to contain only one line.

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

+
+class IncrementalReaderTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    """Test the incremental _count_events_incremental over temporary files."""
+
+    def setUp(self) -> None:
+        self.tmpdir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+        self.events = Path(self.tmpdir.name) / "events.jsonl"
+        # Clear the module cache so tests are isolated.
+        import status_page
+        status_page._events_cache.clear()
+
+    def tearDown(self) -> None:
+        self.tmpdir.cleanup()
+        import status_page
+        status_page._events_cache.clear()
+
+    def test_basic_counts(self) -> None:
+        """3 turn_end, 2 tool_execution_end, 1 text, 1 not json → turns==3, tool_calls==2."""
+        lines = [
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
+            '{"type":"tool_execution_end"}',
+            '{"type":"tool_execution_end"}',
+            '{"type":"text"}',
+            "not json at all",
+        ]
+        self.events.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        import status_page
+        turns, tool_calls = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns, 3)
+        self.assertEqual(tool_calls, 2)
+
+    def test_incremental_append(self) -> None:
+        """Read once (2 turns), append one more turn_end, read again → turns==3."""
+        self.events.write_text(
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"tool_execution_end"}\n',
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+        import status_page
+        turns, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns, 1)
+        # Append another turn_end line.
+        self.events.write_text(
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"tool_execution_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n',
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+        turns, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns, 2)
+
+    def test_incremental_proven_overwrite_first_line(self) -> None:
+        """Read once with 2 turn_end lines; overwrite first line in-place with same byte length; read again → counts unchanged.
+
+        A reader that re-reads from byte 0 would count one extra turn.
+        A correct incremental reader that only reads the appended delta
+        must return the same counts.
+        """
+        # Write two turn_end lines, each exactly 23 bytes ("{\"type\":\"turn_end\"}\n" = 23).
+        line1 = '{"type":"turn_end"}\n'  # 23 bytes
+        line2 = '{"type":"turn_end"}\n'  # 23 bytes
+        self.events.write_text(line1 + line2, encoding="utf-8")
+        import status_page
+        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns1, 2)
+
+        # Overwrite first line in-place with a *different* turn_end line padded
+        # to exactly the same byte length.
+        new_line1 = '{"type":"turn_end  "}\n'  # 23 bytes (same length)
+        with self.events.open("rb") as fh:
+            data = fh.read()
+        # Replace first 23 bytes
+        data = new_line1.encode("utf-8") + data[23:]
+        with self.events.open("wb") as fh:
+            fh.write(data)
+
+        # Read again — a correct incremental reader should NOT re-count.
+        turns2, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns2, 2)  # unchanged
+

            '{"type":"tool_execution_end"}',

            '{"type":"text"}',
            "not json at all",
        ]
        self.events.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        import status_page
        turns, tool_calls = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 3)
        self.assertEqual(tool_calls, 2)

    def test_incremental_append(self) -> None:
        """Read once (2 turns), append one more turn_end, read again → turns==3."""
        self.events.write_text(
            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"tool_execution_end"}\n',
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        import status_page
        turns, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 1)
        # Append another turn_end line.
        self.events.write_text(
            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"tool_execution_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n',
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        turns, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 2)

    def test_incremental_proven_overwrite_first_line(self) -> None:
        """Read once with 2 turn_end lines; overwrite first line in-place with same byte length; read again → counts unchanged.

        A reader that re-reads from byte 0 would count one extra turn.
        A correct incremental reader that only reads the appended delta
        must return the same counts.
        """
        # Write two turn_end lines, each exactly 23 bytes ("{\"type\":\"turn_end\"}\n" = 23).
        line1 = '{"type":"turn_end"}\n'  # 23 bytes
        line2 = '{"type":"turn_end"}\n'  # 23 bytes
        self.events.write_text(line1 + line2, encoding="utf-8")
        import status_page
        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns1, 2)

        # Overwrite first line in-place with a *different* turn_end line padded
        # to exactly the same byte length.
        new_line1 = '{"type":"turn_end  "}\n'  # 23 bytes (same length)
        with self.events.open("rb") as fh:
            data = fh.read()
        # Replace first 23 bytes
        data = new_line1.encode("utf-8") + data[23:]
        with self.events.open("wb") as fh:
            fh.write(data)

        # Read again — a correct incremental reader should NOT re-count.
        turns2, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns2, 2)  # unchanged

    def test_partial_last_line(self) -> None:
        """File ends with incomplete JSON object (no trailing newline); read; complete; read again."""
        # Write one complete line + a partial line.
        self.events.write_text(
            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_en',
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        import status_page
        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns1, 1)  # only the complete line counted

        # Complete the partial line and add a newline.
        self.events.write_text(
            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n',
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        turns2, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns2, 2)  # now counts both

    def test_file_shrinks(self) -> None:
        """File shrinks below stored offset → counts restart from zero."""
        self.events.write_text(
            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n',
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        import status_page
        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns1, 3)

        # Shrink file to contain only one line.
        self.events.write_text('{"type":"turn_end"}\n', encoding="utf-8")
        turns2, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns2, 1)  # restarted from zero

    def test_no_events_file(self) -> None:
        """No events.jsonl → turns==0, tool_calls==0."""
        import status_page
        turns, tool_calls = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 0)
        self.assertEqual(tool_calls, 0)

    def test_last_activity_at_none(self) -> None:
        """No events file → last_activity_at is None, seconds_ago is None."""
        import status_page
        iso, secs = status_page._last_activity_at(self.events)
        self.assertIsNone(iso)
        self.assertIsNone(secs)

    def test_last_activity_seconds_ago(self) -> None:
        """Set file mtime to now−42s → last_activity_seconds_ago ≈ 42.0."""
        import status_page
        # Create the file so it has a real mtime.
        self.events.write_text("{}\n", encoding="utf-8")
        now = datetime(2026, 8, 19, 10, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

class PipelineGroupTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Test pipeline grouping in collect_status."""

    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.tmpdir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.runs = Path(self.tmpdir.name) / "runs"
        self.runs.mkdir()
        self.now = datetime(2026, 8, 19, 10, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.tmpdir.cleanup()

    def test_two_pipelines_grouped(self) -> None:
        """Three f03 runs (one running, two finished) + one no-pipeline → two groups."""
        # f03 running
        _write_started(self.runs, "f03-r1", "task", "F03 running",
                       "2026-08-19T10:00:00+00:00", pipeline="f03")
        # f03 finished (newer)
        run_dir_f2 = _write_started(self.runs, "f03-f1", "task", "F03 finished",
                                    "2026-08-19T09:00:00+00:00", pipeline="f03")
        _write_terminal(run_dir_f2, "run.json", "2026-08-19T09:05:00+00:00")
        # f03 finished (older)
        run_dir_f3 = _write_started(self.runs, "f03-f2", "task", "F03 old",
                                    "2026-08-19T08:00:00+00:00", pipeline="f03")
        _write_terminal(run_dir_f3, "run.json", "2026-08-19T08:05:00+00:00")
        # No pipeline
        run_dir_np = _write_started(self.runs, "np-1", "task", "No pipeline",
                                    "2026-08-19T09:30:00+00:00")
        _write_terminal(run_dir_np, "run.json", "2026-08-19T09:35:00+00:00")

        result = collect_status(self.runs, self.now)
        groups = result["groups"]
        self.assertEqual(len(groups), 2)

        # First group: f03
        f03_group = groups[0]
        self.assertEqual(f03_group["pipeline"], "f03")
        self.assertEqual(f03_group["running"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(f03_group["finished"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(f03_group["runs"], ["f03-r1", "f03-f1", "f03-f2"])

        # Second group: no pipeline
        null_group = groups[1]
        self.assertIsNone(null_group["pipeline"])
        self.assertEqual(null_group["running"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(null_group["finished"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(null_group["runs"], ["np-1"])

    def test_pipeline_in_run_records(self) -> None:
        """Every run record (running and finished) gains a pipeline key."""
        run_dir = _write_started(self.runs, "rp1", "task", "R1",
                                 "2026-08-19T10:00:00+00:00", pipeline="f03")
        _write_terminal(run_dir, "run.json", "2026-08-19T10:01:00+00:00")
        _write_started(self.runs, "rp2", "task", "R2",
                       "2026-08-19T10:05:00+00:00", pipeline="f03")
        result = collect_status(self.runs, self.now)
        self.assertEqual(result["recent"][0].get("pipeline"), "f03")
        self.assertEqual(result["current"].get("pipeline"), "f03")

    def test_pipeline_null_when_missing(self) -> None:
        """Run without pipeline key → pipeline is None in record and groups."""
        run_dir = _write_started(self.runs, "pn", "task", "Plain",
                                 "2026-08-19T10:00:00+00:00")
        _write_terminal(run_dir, "run.json", "2026-08-19T10:01:00+00:00")
        result = collect_status(self.runs, self.now)
        self.assertIsNone(result["recent"][0].get("pipeline"))
        null_groups = [g for g in result["groups"] if g["pipeline"] is None]
        self.assertEqual(len(null_groups), 1)

    def test_group_runs_includes_all_not_only_recent(self) -> None:
        """Twelve finished f03 runs → recent has 10, but group runs has 12."""
        for i in range(12):
            run_dir = _write_started(
                self.runs, f"f03-f{i:02d}", "task", f"F03 run {i}",
                f"2026-08-19T{10 + i:02d}:00:00+00:00", pipeline="f03",
            )
            _write_terminal(run_dir, "run.json",
                            f"2026-08-19T{10 + i:02d}:01:00+00:00")
        result = collect_status(self.runs, self.now)
        self.assertEqual(len(result["recent"]), 10)
        f03_groups = [g for g in result["groups"] if g["pipeline"] == "f03"]
        self.assertEqual(len(f03_groups), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(f03_groups[0]["runs"]), 12)

class JsonConsistencyTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Verify that /status.json matches collect_status and that no files are modified."""

    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.tmpdir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.runs = Path(self.tmpdir.name) / "runs"
        self.runs.mkdir()
        self._populate()
        self._start_server()

    def _populate(self) -> None:
        _write_started(self.runs, "jc1", "task", "Json test",
                       "2026-08-19T10:00:00+00:00", pipeline="f03")
        run_dir = _write_started(self.runs, "jc2", "task", "Done",
                                 "2026-08-19T09:00:00+00:00", pipeline="f03")
        _write_terminal(run_dir, "run.json", "2026-08-19T09:05:00+00:00")

    def _start_server(self) -> None:
        from status_page import DEFAULT_HOST, ThreadingHTTPServer, _StatusHandler
        self._handler_class = type(
            "_JsonStatusHandler",
            (_StatusHandler,),
            {"_runs_dir": self.runs},
        )
        self.server = ThreadingHTTPServer((DEFAULT_HOST, 0), self._handler_class)
        self.port = self.server.server_address[1]
        self.server_thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        self.server_thread.start()

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.server.shutdown()
        self.tmpdir.cleanup()

    def test_status_json_matches_collect_status(self) -> None:
        """GET /status.json body (minus generated_at and *_seconds_ago) equals collect_status."""
        resp = urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}/status.json")
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
        ref_now = datetime.fromisoformat(data.pop("generated_at"))
        expected = collect_status(self.runs, ref_now)
        expected.pop("generated_at")
        # Strip *_seconds_ago for comparison (they depend on request time).
        for run_list in ("running", "recent"):
            for r in data.get(run_list, []):
                r.pop("last_activity_seconds_ago", None)
        for r in expected.get("running", []):
            r.pop("last_activity_seconds_ago", None)
        self.assertEqual(data, expected)

    def test_read_only(self) -> None:
        """collect_status and HTTP requests must not create or modify any file."""
        def _snapshot() -> set[str]:
            paths = set()
            for p in self.runs.rglob("*"):
                if p.is_file():
                    paths.add(str(p))
            return paths

        before = _snapshot()

        # collect_status
        import status_page
        collect_status(self.runs, datetime.now(timezone.utc))

        # HTTP requests
        urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}/status.json")
        urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}/")

        after = _snapshot()
        self.assertEqual(before, after,
                         f"Files changed: +{after - before} -{before - after}")

+ 747         line2 = '{"type":"turn_end"}\n'  # 23 bytes

+class IncrementalReaderTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    """Test the incremental _count_events_incremental over temporary files."""
+
+    def setUp(self) -> None:
+        self.tmpdir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+        self.events = Path(self.tmpdir.name) / "events.jsonl"

+    def tearDown(self) -> None:
+        self.tmpdir.cleanup()

+        status_page._events_cache.clear()
+
+    def test_basic_counts(self) -> None:
+        """3 turn_end, 2 tool_execution_end, 1 text, 1 not json → turns==3, tool_calls==2."""
+        lines = [
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
+            '{"type":"tool_execution_end"}',
+            '{"type":"tool_execution_end"}',
+            '{"type":"text"}',
+            "not json at all",
+        ]
+        self.events.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        import status_page
+        turns, tool_calls = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns, 3)
+        self.assertEqual(tool_calls, 2)
+
+    def test_incremental_append(self) -> None:
+        """Read once (2 turns), append one more turn_end, read again → turns==3."""
+        self.events.write_text(
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"tool_execution_end"}\n',
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+        import status_page
+        turns, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns, 1)
+        # Append another turn_end line.
+        self.events.write_text(
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"tool_execution_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n',
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+        turns, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns, 2)
+
+    def test_incremental_proven_overwrite_first_line(self) -> None:
+        """Read once with 2 turn_end lines; overwrite first line in-place with same byte length; read again → counts unchanged.
+
+        A reader that re-reads from byte 0 would count one extra turn.
+        A correct incremental reader that only reads the appended delta
+        must return the same counts.
+        """
+        # Write two turn_end lines, each exactly 23 bytes ("{\"type\":\"turn_end\"}\n" = 23).
+        line1 = '{"type":"turn_end"}\n'  # 23 bytes
+        line2 = '{"type":"turn_end"}\n'  # 23 bytes
+        self.events.write_text(line1 + line2, encoding="utf-8")
+        import status_page
+        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns1, 2)
+
+        # Overwrite first line in-place with a *different* turn_end line padded
+        # to exactly the same byte length.
+        new_line1 = '{"type":"turn_end  "}\n'  # 23 bytes (same length)
+        with self.events.open("rb") as fh:
+            data = fh.read()
+        # Replace first 23 bytes
+        data = new_line1.encode("utf-8") + data[23:]
+        with self.events.open("wb") as fh:
+            fh.write(data)
+
+        # Read again — a correct incremental reader should NOT re-count.
+        turns2, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns2, 2)  # unchanged
+
+    def test_partial_last_line(self) -> None:
+        """File ends with incomplete JSON object (no trailing newline); read; complete; read again."""
+        # Write one complete line + a partial line.
+        self.events.write_text(
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_en',
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+        import status_page
+        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns1, 1)  # only the complete line counted
+
+        # Complete the partial line and add a newline.
+        self.events.write_text(
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n',
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+        turns2, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns2, 2)  # now counts both
+
+    def test_file_shrinks(self) -> None:
+        """File shrinks below stored offset → counts restart from zero."""
+        self.events.write_text(
+            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n',
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+        import status_page
+        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns1, 3)
+
+        # Shrink file to contain only one line.
+        self.events.write_text('{"type":"turn_end"}\n', encoding="utf-8")
+        turns2, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
+        self.assertEqual(turns2, 1)  # restarted from zero

    """Return *(iso_timestamp, seconds_ago)* for *path*'s mtime.

    if now is None:

    mtime = path.stat().st_mtime
    mtime_dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(mtime, tz=timezone.utc)

    seconds_ago = round((now - mtime_dt).total_seconds(), 1)

class IncrementalReaderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Test the incremental _count_events_incremental over temporary files."""

    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.tmpdir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.events = Path(self.tmpdir.name) / "events.jsonl"
        # Clear the module cache so tests are isolated.
        import status_page
        status_page._events_cache.clear()

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.tmpdir.cleanup()
        import status_page
        status_page._events_cache.clear()

    def test_basic_counts(self) -> None:
        """3 turn_end, 2 tool_execution_end, 1 text, 1 not json → turns==3, tool_calls==2."""
        lines = [
            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
            '{"type":"tool_execution_end"}',
            '{"type":"tool_execution_end"}',
            '{"type":"text"}',
            "not json at all",
        ]
        self.events.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        import status_page
        turns, tool_calls = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 3)
        self.assertEqual(tool_calls, 2)

    def test_incremental_append(self) -> None:
        """Read once (2 turns), append one more turn_end, read again → turns==3."""
        self.events.write_text(
            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"tool_execution_end"}\n',
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        import status_page
        turns, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 1)
        # Append another turn_end line.
        self.events.write_text(
            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"tool_execution_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n',
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        turns, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 2)

    def test_incremental_proven_overwrite_first_line(self) -> None:
        """Read once with 2 turn_end lines; overwrite first line in-place with same byte length; read again → counts unchanged.

        A reader that re-reads from byte 0 would count one extra turn.
        A correct incremental reader that only reads the appended delta
        must return the same counts.
        """
        # Write two turn_end lines, each exactly 23 bytes ("{\"type\":\"turn_end\"}\n" = 23).
        line1 = '{"type":"turn_end"}\n'  # 23 bytes
        line2 = '{"type":"turn_end"}\n'  # 23 bytes
        self.events.write_text(line1 + line2, encoding="utf-8")
        import status_page
        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns1, 2)

        # Overwrite first line in-place with a *different* turn_end line padded
        # to exactly the same byte length.
        new_line1 = '{"type":"turn_end  "}\n'  # 23 bytes (same length)
        with self.events.open("rb") as fh:
            data = fh.read()
        # Replace first 23 bytes
        data = new_line1.encode("utf-8") + data[23:]
        with self.events.open("wb") as fh:
            fh.write(data)

        # Read again — a correct incremental reader should NOT re-count.
        turns2, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns2, 2)  # unchanged

    def test_partial_last_line(self) -> None:
        """File ends with incomplete JSON object (no trailing newline); read; complete; read again."""
        # Write one complete line + a partial line.
        self.events.write_text(
            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_en',
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        import status_page
        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns1, 1)  # only the complete line counted

        # Complete the partial line and add a newline.
        self.events.write_text(
            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n',
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        turns2, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns2, 2)  # now counts both

    def test_file_shrinks(self) -> None:
        """File shrinks below stored offset → counts restart from zero."""
        self.events.write_text(
            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n',
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        import status_page
        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns1, 3)

        # Shrink file to contain only one line.
        self.events.write_text('{"type":"turn_end"}\n', encoding="utf-8")
        turns2, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns2, 1)  # restarted from zero

    def test_no_events_file(self) -> None:
        """No events.jsonl → turns==0, tool_calls==0."""
        import status_page
        turns, tool_calls = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 0)
        self.assertEqual(tool_calls, 0)

    def test_last_activity_at_none(self) -> None:
        """No events file → last_activity_at is None, seconds_ago is None."""
        import status_page
        iso, secs = status_page._last_activity_at(self.events)
        self.assertIsNone(iso)
        self.assertIsNone(secs)

    def test_last_activity_seconds_ago(self) -> None:
        """Set file mtime to now−42s → last_activity_seconds_ago ≈ 42.0."""
        import status_page
        # Create the file so it has a real mtime.
        self.events.write_text("{}\n", encoding="utf-8")
        now = datetime(2026, 8, 19, 10, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        mtime = now.timestamp() - 42
        os.utime(self.events, (mtime, mtime))
        iso, secs = status_page._last_activity_at(self.events)
        self.assertIsNotNone(iso)
        self.assertIsNotNone(secs)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(secs, 42.0, delta=0.5)

class IncrementalReaderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Test the incremental _count_events_incremental over temporary files."""

    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.tmpdir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.events = Path(self.tmpdir.name) / "events.jsonl"
        # Clear the module cache so tests are isolated.
        import status_page
        status_page._events_cache.clear()

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.tmpdir.cleanup()
        import status_page
        status_page._events_cache.clear()

    def _write_events(self, lines: list[bytes]) -> None:
        """Write *lines* (raw bytes) to the events file."""
        self.events.write_bytes(b"\n".join(lines) + b"\n")

    def _write_events_raw(self, data: bytes) -> None:
        """Write exact bytes to the events file."""
        self.events.write_bytes(data)

    def test_basic_counts(self) -> None:
        """3 turn_end, 2 tool_execution_end, 1 text, 1 not json → turns==3, tool_calls==2."""
        lines = [
            b'{"type":"turn_end"}',
            b'{"type":"turn_end"}',
            b'{"type":"turn_end"}',
            b'{"type":"tool_execution_end"}',
            b'{"type":"tool_execution_end"}',
            b'{"type":"text"}',
            b"not json at all",
        ]
        self._write_events(lines)
        import status_page
        turns, tool_calls = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 3)
        self.assertEqual(tool_calls, 2)

    def test_incremental_append(self) -> None:
        """Read once (1 turn), append one more turn_end, read again → turns==2."""
        self._write_events([
            b'{"type":"turn_end"}',
            b'{"type":"tool_execution_end"}',
        ])
        import status_page
        turns, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 1)
        # Append another turn_end line.
        self._write_events([
            b'{"type":"turn_end"}',
            b'{"type":"tool_execution_end"}',
            b'{"type":"turn_end"}',
        ])
        turns, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 2)

    def test_incremental_proven_overwrite_first_line(self) -> None:
        """Read once with 2 turn_end lines; overwrite first line in-place with same byte length; read again → counts unchanged.

        A reader that re-reads from byte 0 would count one extra turn.
        A correct incremental reader that only reads the appended delta
        must return the same counts.
        """
        # Each line is exactly 20 bytes: {"type":"turn_end"}\n = 20 bytes
        line = b'{"type":"turn_end"}\n'  # 20 bytes
        self._write_events_raw(line + line)  # 40 bytes total
        import status_page
        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns1, 2)

        # Overwrite first line in-place with a *different* turn_end line padded
        # to exactly the same byte length (20 bytes).
        new_line = b'{"type":"turn_end  "}\n'  # 20 bytes (same length)
        with self.events.open("rb") as fh:
            data = fh.read()
        self.assertEqual(len(data), 40)
        # Replace first 20 bytes
        data = new_line + data[20:]
        with self.events.open("wb") as fh:
            fh.write(data)

        # Read again — a correct incremental reader should NOT re-count.
        turns2, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns2, 2)  # unchanged

    def test_partial_last_line(self) -> None:
        """File ends with incomplete JSON object (no trailing newline); read; complete; read again."""
        # Write one complete line + a partial line.
        self.events.write_bytes(b'{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_en')
        import status_page
        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns1, 1)  # only the complete line counted

        # Complete the partial line and add a newline.
        self.events.write_bytes(b'{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n')
        turns2, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns2, 2)  # now counts both

    def test_file_shrinks(self) -> None:
        """File shrinks below stored offset → counts restart from zero."""
        self._write_events([
            b'{"type":"turn_end"}',
            b'{"type":"turn_end"}',
            b'{"type":"turn_end"}',
        ])
        import status_page
        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns1, 3)

        # Shrink file to contain only one line.
        self.events.write_bytes(b'{"type":"turn_end"}\n')
        turns2, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns2, 1)  # restarted from zero

    def test_no_events_file(self) -> None:
        """No events.jsonl → turns==0, tool_calls==0."""
        import status_page
        turns, tool_calls = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 0)
        self.assertEqual(tool_calls, 0)

    def test_last_activity_at_none(self) -> None:
        """No events file → last_activity_at is None, seconds_ago is None."""
        import status_page
        iso, secs = status_page._last_activity_at(self.events)
        self.assertIsNone(iso)
        self.assertIsNone(secs)

    def test_last_activity_seconds_ago(self) -> None:
        """Set file mtime to now−42s → last_activity_seconds_ago ≈ 42.0."""
        import status_page
        # Create the file so it has a real mtime.
        self.events.write_bytes(b'{}\n')
        now = datetime(2026, 8, 19, 10, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        mtime = now.timestamp() - 42
        os.utime(self.events, (mtime, mtime))
        iso, secs = status_page._last_activity_at(self.events, now)
        self.assertIsNotNone(iso)
        self.assertIsNotNone(secs)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(secs, 42.0, delta=0.5)

class IncrementalReaderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Test the incremental _count_events_incremental over temporary files."""

    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.tmpdir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.events = Path(self.tmpdir.name) / "events.jsonl"
        # Clear the module cache so tests are isolated.
        import status_page
        status_page._events_cache.clear()

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.tmpdir.cleanup()
        import status_page
        status_page._events_cache.clear()

    def test_basic_counts(self) -> None:
        """3 turn_end, 2 tool_execution_end, 1 text, 1 not json → turns==3, tool_calls==2."""
        lines = [
            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
            '{"type":"turn_end"}',
            '{"type":"tool_execution_end"}',
            '{"type":"tool_execution_end"}',
            '{"type":"text"}',
            "not json at all",
        ]
        self.events.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        import status_page
        turns, tool_calls = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 3)
        self.assertEqual(tool_calls, 2)

    def test_incremental_append(self) -> None:
        """Read once (2 turns), append one more turn_end, read again → turns==3."""
        self.events.write_text(
            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"tool_execution_end"}\n',
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        import status_page
        turns, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 1)
        # Append another turn_end line.
        self.events.write_text(
            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"tool_execution_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n',
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        turns, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 2)

    def test_incremental_proven_overwrite_first_line(self) -> None:
        """Read once with 2 turn_end lines; overwrite first line in-place with same byte length; read again → counts unchanged.

        A reader that re-reads from byte 0 would count one extra turn.
        A correct incremental reader that only reads the appended delta
        must return the same counts.
        """
        # Write two turn_end lines, each exactly 23 bytes ("{\"type\":\"turn_end\"}\n" = 23).
        line1 = '{"type":"turn_end"}\n'  # 23 bytes
        line2 = '{"type":"turn_end"}\n'  # 23 bytes
        self.events.write_text(line1 + line2, encoding="utf-8")
        import status_page
        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns1, 2)

        # Overwrite first line in-place with a *different* turn_end line padded
        # to exactly the same byte length.
        new_line1 = '{"type":"turn_end  "}\n'  # 23 bytes (same length)
        with self.events.open("rb") as fh:
            data = fh.read()
        # Replace first 23 bytes
        data = new_line1.encode("utf-8") + data[23:]
        with self.events.open("wb") as fh:
            fh.write(data)

        # Read again — a correct incremental reader should NOT re-count.
        turns2, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns2, 2)  # unchanged

    def test_partial_last_line(self) -> None:
        """File ends with incomplete JSON object (no trailing newline); read; complete; read again."""
        # Write one complete line + a partial line.
        self.events.write_text(
            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_en',
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        import status_page
        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns1, 1)  # only the complete line counted

        # Complete the partial line and add a newline.
        self.events.write_text(
            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n',
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        turns2, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns2, 2)  # now counts both

    def test_file_shrinks(self) -> None:
        """File shrinks below stored offset → counts restart from zero."""
        self.events.write_text(
            '{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n{"type":"turn_end"}\n',
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        import status_page
        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns1, 3)

        # Shrink file to contain only one line.
        self.events.write_text('{"type":"turn_end"}\n', encoding="utf-8")
        turns2, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns2, 1)  # restarted from zero

    def test_no_events_file(self) -> None:
        """No events.jsonl → turns==0, tool_calls==0."""
        import status_page
        turns, tool_calls = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 0)
        self.assertEqual(tool_calls, 0)

    def test_last_activity_at_none(self) -> None:
        """No events file → last_activity_at is None, seconds_ago is None."""
        import status_page
        iso, secs = status_page._last_activity_at(self.events)
        self.assertIsNone(iso)
        self.assertIsNone(secs)

    def test_last_activity_seconds_ago(self) -> None:
        """Set file mtime to now−42s → last_activity_seconds_ago ≈ 42.0."""
        import status_page
        # Create the file so it has a real mtime.
        self.events.write_text("{}\n", encoding="utf-8")
        now = datetime(2026, 8, 19, 10, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        mtime = now.timestamp() - 42
        os.utime(self.events, (mtime, mtime))
        iso, secs = status_page._last_activity_at(self.events)
        self.assertIsNotNone(iso)
        self.assertIsNotNone(secs)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(secs, 42.0, delta=0.5)

        self.tmpdir.cleanup()

        """Write exact bytes to the events file."""
        self.events.write_bytes(data)

        self.assertEqual(turns, 3)
        self.assertEqual(tool_calls, 2)

        """Read once (1 turn), append one more turn_end, read again → turns==2."""
        self._write_events([
            b'{"type":"turn_end"}',
            b'{"type":"tool_execution_end"}',
        ])
        import status_page
        turns, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 1)
        # Append another turn_end line.
        self._write_events([
            b'{"type":"turn_end"}',
            b'{"type":"tool_execution_end"}',
            b'{"type":"turn_end"}',
        ])
        turns, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns, 2)

        turns1, _ = status_page._count_events_incremental(self.events)
        self.assertEqual(turns1, 2)

        # to exactly the same byte length (20 bytes).
        new_line = b'{"type":"turn_end  "}\n'  # 20 bytes (same length)
        with self.events.open("rb") as fh:

        self.assertEqual(turns, 0)
        self.assertEqual(tool_calls, 0)

    def test_last_activity_at_none(self) -> None:
        """No events file → last_activity_at is None, seconds_ago is None."""
        import status_page
        iso, secs = status_page._last_activity_at(self.events)
        self.assertIsNone(iso)
        self.assertIsNone(secs)

    def test_last_activity_seconds_ago(self) -> None:
        """Set file mtime to now−42s → last_activity_seconds_ago ≈ 42.0."""
        import status_page
        # Create the file so it has a real mtime.

        self.assertIsNotNone(iso)
        self.assertIsNotNone(secs)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(secs, 42.0, delta=0.5)
